text: ポケモンを　そだてるのに　とても　よい　かんきょうだわ

structure.jp: ポケモンを　そだてるのに
とても　よい　かんきょうだわ

patterns.name: 〜のに (purpose)
patterns.explanation: のに after a plain verb here means 'for doing that'. It is not the のに that means 'even though'. そだてるのに = 'for raising them'.

patterns.name: 〜わ
patterns.explanation: わ at the end of a sentence is soft, womanly speech that adds a light touch of feeling. かんきょうだわ = 'it's quite an environment'.
